questions.q: What free service does the testing guide suggest for continuous integration?
options: Manual test runs before each release
questions.why: The guide specifically calls out GitHub Actions' generous free tier for running the suite on every push.

questions.q: What does containerizing the app with Docker guarantee, per the guide?
options: That the app runs identically in a container and on a laptop
questions.why: The guide states containerizing makes 'works on my machine' mean every machine — the app runs identically in a container and on a laptop.

questions.q: Where should secrets and URLs come from, according to the testing stage guide?
questions.why: The guide says all secrets and URLs should come from environment variables — this is 'externalizing configuration.'
